v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given a calendar with events "9:00-10:00", "13:00-14:00" on a Friday when searching for a 60-min meeting on Fri then the system returns ["10:00", "10:30", "11:00", "11:30", "12:00", "12:30", "14:00"]
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given a calendar with events "9:00-11:00", "11:50-12:50", "16:15-17:00" on a Friday when searching for a 45 min meeting on Mon then return a ["10:00-12:00", "12:50-15:00"]
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given events ["10:00-12:00", "12:00-15:00"] when requesting a 60-minute meeting then return ["9:00", "15:00"]
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given events ["9:00-15:00"] when requesting 120-minute meeting then return ["15:00"]
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given events ["9:00-10:00", "15:00-16:00"] when requesting 15-min meeting then return ["10:00", "10:30", "11:00", ..., "16:30"] at 30 min intervals

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: The day parameter must be a three letter abbreviation
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Input events may be provided in order
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: The system must internally sort events by start time v1_human processing to correctly identify gaps
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: All times are treated as local

v2_human_g2_input: events: List[Dict[str, str]], meeting_duration: int, day: str
